text: England host New Zealand again in the Nations Championship third-place play-off, a week after their record 37-12 win, with Steve Borthwick making five changes.
Stephen Bunting beat Max Hopp 6-5 at the Players Championship Finals, where Gerwyn Price and top seed Wessel Nijman both went out in round one.
Gukesh and Sindarov return for Game 4 of the world championship on Saturday, level at 1.5-1.5 after a 60-move draw in Game 3.
The UK Championship snooker opens at the York Barbican on Saturday and runs to 6 December, with sessions at 1 PM and 7 PM UK time.
England beat Australia by seven wickets (DLS) in the third T20I as Jamie Overton took a career-best 5 for 12, and lead the series 2-1.
Charley Hull's Atlanta Drive lost 8-3 to Lottie Woad's Boston Common in the WTGL, though Hull won her singles against Celine Boutier.
Arthur Rinderknech denies refusing an anti-doping test in June after the ITIA confirmed a charge, and has requested an independent tribunal hearing.
